answer.origin: finance.yahoo.com article published 2026-07-01 reporting NN, Inc.'s late-June 2026 announcement; a media summary of a company statement, with no primary NN release in the record and no original announcement day given.
answer.note: Covered company is NVDA; the source is about NN, Inc., a supplier that is not the covered company. The source states NN announced late June 2026 that it would add 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling production for NVIDIA AI data center racks. NN said 100% of the new capacity was already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards, and it targeted US$80-90 million of accretive new business in 2026 (a company target, not a result). For NVDA this is at most a supply-side lead: a supplier is adding Asia-based liquid cooling capacity aimed at NVIDIA rack programs. The link that NVIDIA is the end buyer of this capacity rests on the media framing of the headline; the quoted facts could all hold while the awards go to NN from other rack makers, so NVIDIA-linked demand is an unconfirmed hypothesis, not established. The third-party analyst projections for NN (US$485.5m revenue and US$47.9m earnings by 2028 from a narrative; about US$489.5m and US$48.3m from unnamed analysts) are valuation commentary on NN and carry little weight for NVDA. The Russell Microcap Value Index removal concerns NN's trading and has no bearing on NVDA.
limitations: NVIDIA is named only in the media headline and framing; the excerpt does not state that NVIDIA is the buyer or party to the pre-sold awards.
Customers, counterparties, contract values and term for the multi-year, multi-product awards are not disclosed.
The US$80-90 million figure is a company business target for 2026, not a reported result, and its basis is not given.
No timing is disclosed for installation or production start of the 47 machine centers, or their capital cost.
No NVIDIA-side disclosure or confirmation of NN as a supplier or of this capacity appears in the record.
The original NN announcement date is unknown beyond 'late June 2026'; only the media publication date of 2026-07-01 is known.
follow_up: Retrieve NN's original late-June 2026 press release or 8-K and check whether it names NVIDIA or any rack customer for the pre-sold awards.
Check NVIDIA's latest 10-Q or 10-K for disclosed supplier or purchase-commitment relationships with NN, Inc. or Wuxi-based liquid cooling suppliers.
Check NN's next quarterly filing for the Wuxi expansion's capex, machine-center installation timing, and recognized revenue against the US$80-90 million 2026 target.
Check whether any export-control or trade restriction on China-based rack component production affects NVIDIA rack shipments from the Wuxi facility.
